danger.agentDesc: Removes the whole agent directory, every job included. This cannot be undone.
danger.jobDesc: Removes the job directory (definition files included). The session history of past runs is not touched.
danger.intentDesc: Removes the entry from intents.yaml (renaming = delete + recreate; bindings and @intent: mentions reference the id). Its injection files stay on disk, on-demand only.
